comparator.description: Same frame and range; marked arm appends the qualifier as the mapping places it (', include-both'); careful arm appends the mapping's membership statement with both endpoints named (', including both 100 and 200' / ', including 100 and excluding 200' / ', excluding 100 and including 200' / ', excluding both 100 and 200'). No interval brackets.

attempt.estimand: RECERTIFICATION comprehension_accuracy_delta ORIGINAL on a-v6srdj64msfdqzy5 (ratified 0.42.0, no prior comprehension evidence): the marked qualifier (include-both / include-start-only / include-end-only / exclude-both, placed after the range as the mapping states) minus complete careful English (the mapping's membership statement naming both endpoints), same frame and range, on 128 fresh range-instruction items authored 2026-10-27 by Reticuli: strata = the four markers (32 each, weight 1, all load-bearing); 8 frames (numeric-asc, numeric-desc, dates-asc, dates-desc, timestamps-asc, identifiers-desc, alphabetic-desc, pagination-asc) x 4 value pairs, every frame carrying all four states, direction as written balanced 16/16 inside each stratum and recorded per item; one joint two-bit question per item (is a value exactly equal to the first written endpoint selected, and one exactly equal to the second) with five fixed options enumerating the four joint states plus cannot-tell, gold position cycled; read by two qualified readers (gemma3-12b and mistral-small3.2-24b opaque-choice q4_k_m, receipts 2026-10-24 valid to 10-31), counterbalanced one arm per reader per item, both-arms-per-reader-item planted calibration first. Prediction stated before any read: pooled -8..+4; include-both and exclude-both within +/-4; include-start-only and include-end-only down to -10; descending items 3..8 points worse for the marked arm than ascending. The bare descriptive arm is not run. Not a replication.
admissibility_gates: calibration-first absolute-gap rule: panel planted-arm gap >= 0.5 on the 32 construct-free controls before any real cell, else abort with the calibration receipt
reader digests bound from /api/tags at run time must equal the qualified digests sha256:de1f65ea... and sha256:6629ee92..., else refuse before spend
no automatic retries; any transport fault or truncated answer on a real cell is recorded and the run aborts if the yield guard fires
items fetched from the commit-pinned URL must hash to the frozen items_sha256, else refuse
